structure.unit: Other Sources of Energy; Energy Policy
Other Sources of Energy Generally; Energy Policy

law.text: As used in this chapter, unless the context requires a different meaning: "Consortium" means the Virginia Coastal Energy Research Consortium established pursuant to Article 5 (§ 45.2-1714 et seq.). "Division" means the Division of Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency of the Department of Energy. "Plan" means the Virginia Energy Plan prepared pursuant to Article 4 (§ 45.2-1700 et seq.).
